guitar.modelsText: Gibson SG "The Fool" / Gibson ES-335 / Les Paul
guitar.notes: Well documented Clapton-era gear; entry accurate.

tone.target: bright Plexi blues-rock crunch with biting upper mids
tone.profile: bright Plexi blues-rock crunch with biting upper mids
tone.summary: A classic, crunchy Plexi blues-rock chain using OD 9 for grit, followed by the UK 50 amp model and a vintage 4x12 cabinet to achieve bright upper mids and tight breakup.

blocks.purpose: Clean up hum and background noise.
Provide initial grit and boost the upper mids for Plexi crunch.
Bypass (No dedicated distortion needed; OD 9 handles the crunch).
blocks.gap: The verdict specifies straight amp crunch, so a dedicated DST unit is bypassed.

blocks.purpose: Emulate the bright, mid-focused sound of a Plexi/Marshall stack.
Provide the classic British 4x12 cabinet tone and raw live feel.
Fine-tune the upper mids and overall brightness for biting lead tone.
blocks.gap: Using EQ 2 to specifically boost high frequencies without muddying the core sound.

blocks.purpose: Avoid wah as requested by the musical verdict.
blocks.gap: The verdict explicitly states to drop wah.

blocks.purpose: Add a subtle 'raw live-room feel' without heavy modulation.
blocks.gap: Room reverb is used sparingly to meet the 'raw live-room feel' requirement, avoiding excessive ambience.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism for a more authentic, biting Plexi sound.

proposals.reason: Enhance the bite and upper-mid focus required for Plexi crunch.
proposals.expectedGain: Increased clarity and definition in leads.
